m: Cook the prawns in simmering salted water for 2 minutes until pink. Cool and halve lengthways.
Cook the vermicelli per the packet, rinse cold and drain well.
Cut the carrot and cucumber into thin matchsticks and shred the lettuce. Pick the herbs.
Dipping sauce: fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, chopped chilli and 2 tbsp water per serve, with crushed peanuts on top.
Dip one rice paper sheet in warm water for a few seconds until just soft. Lay prawns cut side down, then herbs, noodles and veg, and roll up tight, tucking in the sides.
Serve straight away with the dipping sauce. About 4 rolls per person.
l: Wrap each roll in a damp paper towel so they don't dry out. Sauce in a separate container.
g: Naturally gluten free with rice paper and rice noodles. Check the fish sauce.
